dsp GenFm2x1PadFb where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 2.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6656

dsp GenFm1x1p414Pad where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 1.414 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.0) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6554

dsp GenFm1x4PluckFb where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.35 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 4.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * ienvA
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6914

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0

  state ienv : F32 := 0.0

  state pm : F32 := 0.0

  sample x =>

    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))

    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.0) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * ienvA
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6926

dsp GenFm1x5Pad where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 5.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.0) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6788

    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))

dsp GenFm1x7PluckFb where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.35 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 7.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * ienvA
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6929

dsp GenFm1x7PadFb where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 7.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6784

dsp GenFm3x1Pluck where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.35 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.0) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * ienvA
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.7908

dsp GenFm3x1PadFb where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.5 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq)
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * (0.4 + ienvA * 0.6)
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6682

fm3x1BassFb.source:
dsp GenFm3x1BassFb where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.6 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.35 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * 0.5
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.35) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * ienvA
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 3.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.7427

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))

    set ienv := ienvA

    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate

dsp GenFm1x2p756Bass where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.6 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state pc : F32 := 0.0
  state pm : F32 := 0.0
  state last : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.35 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * 0.5
    set pm := fract(pm + min(0.45, f * 2.756 / sr))
    let mod := sinpi(pm * 2.0 + last * 0.0) * (0.2 + colour * 2.2) * ienvA
    set last := sinpi(pm * 2.0)
    set pc := fract(pc + min(0.45, f * 1.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((sinpi(pc * 2.0 + mod) * envA) * 0.7) * 0.6787
